records.title: Finance & Accounts Apprenticeships 2026–27
records.location: Multiple Indian work centres; finance trade in Agartala
records.benefit: ₹12,300/month graduate stipend; no promise of permanent employment.
records.eligibility: B.Com/commerce graduates; age 18–24 on 29 November 2026, with category relaxations. Less than three years since qualifying. No previous/current apprenticeship. Residence or qualifying institution must match the work centre's eligible districts in Annexure 1.
records.description: Two commerce routes: Executive Finance (Oil & Gas), including nine Agartala places, and Accounts Executive across several Indian work centres. The advertised 3,047 total covers all trades, not finance alone.
records.applicationSteps: Read the work-centre table. Apply for Executive Finance through apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (NAPS), or Accounts Executive through nats.education.gov.in (NATS), by 20 November.
records.evidence: Official advertisement ONGC/APPR/1/2026 downloaded and read; applications run 29 October–20 November 2026.
records.caveat: Local eligibility matters. Read all exclusions in the notice; work-centre seats are subject to the official selection process. Portal can be slow.

records.title: Finance Apprentice — 2026 graduates
records.benefit: Paid stipend; amount not disclosed. Finance systems training and mentorship.
records.eligibility: 2026 graduates; commerce, accounting or finance bachelor's/master's preferred. No experience required. Basic accounting, Excel, PowerPoint and analytical ability. Local Bengaluru candidates preferred.
records.description: Practical work in reconciliations, invoices, journals, financial reporting, dashboards, ERP tools and Excel models.
records.applicationSteps: Apply through Illumina Workday requisition 43668-JOB with your own application and academic details.
records.evidence: Employer-attributed LinkedIn posting inspected; describes the 2026-graduate programme and remains published until filled or sufficient applicants are received.
records.caveat: No published cutoff or stipend amount. Workday is script-rendered. Illumina prohibits generative AI in applications/interviews; no visa sponsorship.

records.title: Analyst Arena — equity research competition
records.location: India; college teams, with in-person final
records.benefit: Free entry. Top-three cash prizes: ₹1 lakh, ₹75,000 and ₹50,000; additional education benefits have separate terms.
records.duration: Three rounds; timeline assigned by organiser
records.eligibility: Undergraduates in Indian colleges/universities. Team of 3–4 students from the same college; no individual entry. Multiple teams per college allowed.
records.description: Build company research, sector analysis and a final investment presentation. The organiser's own site accepts direct team registration, including colleges without an SSEI seminar.
records.applicationSteps: Form your team and complete the registration form on the official site. Confirm your round-one submission schedule before starting.
records.evidence: Official competition page shows the registration form, free entry, eligibility, round structure and prizes.
records.caveat: No universal closing date published. Campus timelines run relative to the seminar; direct entrants must obtain their schedule. Placement support is not a job guarantee.

records.org: SEBI & National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM)
records.title: SEBI Investor Awareness Test — Level 1
records.benefit: Free study materials and exam; certificate after passing. No stipend or employment.
records.eligibility: No age or educational qualification threshold. Registration requires email and Aadhaar verification through the official portal.
records.description: An accessible introduction to Indian securities markets, savings, investment risk and investor rights. Useful for financial literacy, not a professional licence or job qualification by itself.
records.applicationSteps: Register on the NISM SIAT portal, download the materials and take the exam when ready.
records.evidence: Official live course page and linked FAQ confirm free access, no age/education threshold and on-demand examination.
records.caveat: Learning only: no job, internship or income. Distinct from the paid role-specific NISM professional examinations.

records.title: Investment Banking — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free exercises and completion certificate. No pay.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; no recruiting application. Advanced-level exercise; accounting and valuation familiarity helps.
records.description: Practise company valuation, a DCF model, M&A analysis, financing considerations and a client presentation.
records.applicationSteps: Create a Forage account, start the free simulation and complete the tasks at your own pace.
records.evidence: Official Forage programme page inspected with an active Start Free Simulation route.
records.caveat: A global online learning exercise accessible in India, not an Indian job vacancy, actual internship, work experience or income source.

records.title: Public & Private Credit — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free tasks, model answers and completion certificate. No pay.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; intermediate-level practice. Familiarity with financial statements and Excel is useful.
records.description: Explore public-credit research, private-credit research and portfolio analysis using financial ratios and fixed-income concepts.
records.applicationSteps: Start the free programme on Forage and work through its credit-investment assignments.
records.evidence: Official programme page inspected; free self-paced start remains available.
records.caveat: Learning only, accessible online from India. It is not an internship, employment contract, income opportunity or promise of a PGIM interview.

records.title: Investment Management — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free practice and completion certificate. No income.
records.eligibility: Online programme open to learners; provider explicitly welcomes students of all backgrounds. Intermediate difficulty.
records.description: Explore asset classes, portfolio work, Excel analysis and fund distribution through an investment-manager simulation.
records.applicationSteps: Start the free Forage programme and complete the six learning modules.
records.evidence: Official programme page inspected with free enrolment and stated course duration.
records.caveat: Accessible online in India; practice only. No employment, internship, stipend or guaranteed interview.

records.title: Global Markets Sales & Trading — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free exercises and completion certificate. No pay.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; introductory programme without a recruiting selection process.
records.description: Practise financial-data interpretation, market analysis and client recommendations in a simulated sales-and-trading setting.
records.applicationSteps: Start the free simulation on Forage and follow the task instructions.
records.evidence: Official live programme page inspected; Start Free Simulation available.
records.caveat: Global online practice accessible from India. Not a trading job, actual internship, income opportunity or access to live trading capital.

records.title: Actuarial Analyst — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free exercises and completion certificate. No pay.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; intermediate difficulty. Quantitative and spreadsheet familiarity helps.
records.description: Explore actuarial risk assessment, marine-liability pricing and analytical reporting in a simulated insurance assignment.
records.applicationSteps: Register on Forage, start the free simulation and complete its analysis tasks.
records.evidence: Official programme page inspected with active free enrolment.
records.caveat: Online practice accessible from India; not an actuarial qualification, professional exam exemption, internship or paid job.

records.title: Private Equity Deal Lifecycle — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free introductory exercises and completion certificate. No pay.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; introductory difficulty and no hiring application.
records.description: Explore the private-equity transaction lifecycle, valuation and how investment and operating teams contribute to a deal.
records.applicationSteps: Create a Forage account and start the free deal-lifecycle simulation.
records.evidence: Official programme page opened with active free start and introductory course details.
records.caveat: Global online learning available from India. Not a PE internship, professional work experience, income opportunity or Indian hiring opening.

records.title: Controllers — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free exercises and completion certificate. No pay.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; introductory-level practice without a hiring selection process.
records.description: Try controllers work involving financial information, net asset value and data reconciliation.
records.applicationSteps: Start the free Goldman Sachs Controllers simulation on Forage and complete the exercise.
records.evidence: Official live Forage page inspected with stated duration and free start.
records.caveat: Online learning accessible from India. Not a Goldman Sachs internship, job, income opportunity or guarantee of recruitment.

records.title: Venture Capital — free job simulation
records.benefit: Free exercises and completion certificate. No stipend.
records.eligibility: Open online enrolment; introductory-level practice without a recruiting application.
records.description: Evaluate a startup, practise financial modelling and compare investment opportunities using a venture-capital case study.
records.applicationSteps: Start the free H2 Ventures programme on Forage and work through the simulation tasks.
records.evidence: Official Forage programme page inspected with an available free simulation.
records.caveat: Global online learning accessible in India. Despite older 'virtual internship' wording, this is a simulation, not employment, income or an Indian internship vacancy.

records.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge — India route
records.location: Indian university teams; local and national rounds
records.benefit: Equity-research practice, faculty guidance and industry mentoring; competition participation, not paid employment.
records.duration: Annual competition; confirm current Indian schedule
records.eligibility: Team entry through a participating university. Students must satisfy the current year's CFA Institute rules; not unrestricted solo registration.
records.description: Research a company, prepare a written equity report and defend the recommendation in presentations across competition rounds.
records.applicationSteps: Ask your faculty coordinator and contact team@iaipirc.org through the official India page about 2026–27 participation.
records.evidence: Official India route remains published, but the inspected page linked prior-cycle rules and did not establish an open 2026–27 team-entry deadline.
records.caveat: Watchlist only: current new-team admission is unverified. Institution/team restrictions apply; do not treat the existence of an annual programme as an open call.

records.title: National Financial Literacy Quiz 2026 — college route
records.location: Indian colleges; regional and national rounds
records.benefit: Financial-literacy practice and participation recognition; prizes depend on the competition round. No job or stipend.
records.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate college students, in separate competition cohorts; college coordination required.
records.description: A financial-literacy competition progressing from online and college rounds to regional and national stages.
records.applicationSteps: Use the official page's college-round interest route and ask NISM whether your college can still enter.
records.evidence: Official homepage has a college-round enquiry link but already announces college winners and regional qualifiers; fresh-entry availability is not established.
records.caveat: Watchlist/enquiry only, not verified open registration. Existing competitors and new applicants have different timelines.

records.title: Summer Placement 2027 — verify current RBI notice
records.location: RBI offices in India; allocation rules apply
records.benefit: Research placement; check the current RBI notice for stipend and expenses before applying.
records.duration: Typically up to three months, April–July 2027
records.eligibility: Indian citizens studying in India, generally penultimate-year postgraduate/integrated programmes in relevant finance, economics, management, statistics or law disciplines; verify degree-specific rules with RBI.
records.description: A separate student summer-placement route from RBI's longer Research Internship programme.
records.applicationSteps: Read RBI's Summer Placement page, confirm 2027 eligibility and use its official online application route.
records.evidence: AAG Legal's 6 October 2026 listing identifies the 15 October–15 December application window. RBI's linked page presented a human-verification challenge during this audit.
records.caveat: Watchlist pending direct RBI verification; dates are third-party corroboration, not a freshly verified open form. No assumed ₹25,000 stipend without the current primary notice.
